title: Grand Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand
alt: Limestone islands rising from the water in Halong Bay, Vietnam
transport: Four included internal flights with private and shared transfers

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Three countries, four internal flights already included, and the pace eases off as you go south.
expert.tip: Pack one small bag for the Halong cruise night and leave the rest in Hanoi. Carry US dollars in small notes for Cambodia, where they are used as often as riel.

summary: Sixteen days through Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand with four internal flights included. Ninh Binh and a Halong Bay cruise, the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, Angkor Wat and Tonle Sap, then the Grand Palace, Coral Island and the Phi Phi islands.
included: Included: 15 nights in 7 hotels and one cruise cabin with daily breakfast; four internal flights, Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City to Siem Reap, Siem Reap to Bangkok and U Tapao to Phuket; Ninh Binh day tour with the Bich Dong cycle ride; Halong Bay overnight cruise; Ho Chi Minh city tour, Cu Chi tunnels and a Mekong Delta day; Tonle Sap boat ride and the Angkor Wat day tour; Bangkok city tour with the Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha; Coral Island speedboat tour; Phi Phi islands excursion with lunch; 33 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights into Hanoi and out of Phuket; visa charges for Vietnam, Cambodia and Thailand; travel insurance; temple and park entry fees not listed; meals other than those listed; personal expenses.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Hm Boutique in the old quarter of Hanoi

program.name: Old quarter and the Ninh Binh karst
program.description: Two nights in Hanoi with a day out to Ninh Binh, a sampan ride between the karst hills and a cycle to Bich Dong pagoda.

activities.name: Ninh Binh Day Tour
activities.description: A day south of Hanoi among limestone hills and flooded rice fields, with a rowed sampan through the caves and channels.

activities.name: Bich Dong Cycle Ride
activities.description: A flat ride out through the villages to the Bich Dong pagoda, built into the rock on three levels.

activities.name: Temple of Literature
activities.description: Vietnam's first university, a walled garden of courtyards and stelae in the middle of the city.

activities.name: Hoan Kiem Lake
activities.description: The lake at the heart of the old quarter, with Ngoc Son temple on its island and the streets busiest at dusk.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Standard cabin · 3★ · Overnight on the Halong Royal Palace cruise at anchor in the bay

program.name: A night among the limestone islands
program.description: Sailing out from the harbour into Halong Bay, with kayaking, swimming stops and a cabin on board for the night.

activities.name: Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
activities.description: A cruise out among the limestone islands with kayaking, swimming stops and a night at anchor in a quiet channel.

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Back at Hm Boutique in Hanoi for one more night

program.name: Caves, then back to the city
program.description: A morning cruise through the Dark and Bright caves, then back to Hanoi with the evening free in the old quarter.

activities.name: Halong Bay Morning Cruise
activities.description: The last hours on the water, cruising the quieter channels of the bay before the boat docks at the harbour.

activities.name: Dark and Bright Cave
activities.description: A small boat passage through a low cave into a hidden lagoon ringed by cliffs, rowed by hand.

activities.name: Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum
activities.description: The marble mausoleum on Ba Dinh square, with the presidential palace grounds and the stilt house alongside.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Avanti Saigon in District 1, walkable to the old centre

program.name: Saigon, the tunnels and the delta
program.description: Three nights in the south with a city tour, a half day at the Cu Chi tunnels and a full day out on the Mekong Delta.

activities.name: Ho Chi Minh City Tour
activities.description: A shared tour through the colonial centre of Saigon, its landmarks and the markets, with time to walk.

activities.name: Cu Chi Tunnels
activities.description: A half day at the tunnel network north of the city, with a cleared section you can crawl and the traps and workshops above.

activities.name: Mekong Delta Day Tour
activities.description: A full day down at My Tho with boats out to the islands, sampans along the canals and coconut candy workshops.

activities.name: Saigon River Front
activities.description: The promenade along the river, best in the early evening when the city lights come on across the water.

stops.name: Siem Reap
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 3★ · HARI Residence and Spa, a short ride from Pub Street

program.name: Tonle Sap and the Angkor temples
program.description: Two nights in Siem Reap with a boat ride on Tonle Sap lake and a full day across the Angkor temples.

activities.name: Tonle Sap Lake Boat Ride
activities.description: A boat out onto the lake past floating villages, schools and markets that rise and fall with the water.

activities.name: Angkor Wat Day Tour
activities.description: A full day across the Angkor park, from Angkor Wat itself to the Bayon faces of Angkor Thom and the roots at Ta Prohm.

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Super Deluxe room · 4★ · Ambassador Hotel on Sukhumvit, close to the Skytrain

program.name: The Grand Palace and the city
program.description: Two nights in the Thai capital with a tour of the Grand Palace and the Emerald Buddha, and a free evening for markets.

activities.name: Bangkok City Tour with the Grand Palace
activities.description: A shared tour of the Grand Palace complex and Wat Phra Kaew, where the Emerald Buddha sits above the main hall.

activities.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.description: Thousands of stalls across a vast weekend market, best reached by Skytrain and best walked early.

stops.name: Pattaya
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Standard room · 3★ · Golden Tulip Essential, a short walk from the beach road

program.name: Coral Island and the markets
program.description: Two nights on the Gulf coast with a speedboat day at Koh Larn and the night bazaar close by in the evening.

activities.name: Coral Island by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day out to Koh Larn with clear water at Tawaen beach, loungers on the sand and water sports if you want them.

activities.name: Pattaya Floating Market
activities.description: Four sections of stilted walkways and boats selling food and crafts across a lake south of the city.

activities.name: Pattaya Night Bazaar
activities.description: Stalls of clothes, souvenirs and street food along the beach road, busiest from early evening onwards.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Super Deluxe room · 4★ · Journeyhub in Patong, minutes from the beach

program.name: Patong and the Phi Phi islands
program.description: The last two nights in Patong with a full day out at the Phi Phi islands before the flight home.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands Excursion
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave and Monkey Beach, and lunch served on the tour.

activities.name: Simon Cabaret Show
activities.description: Phuket's best known cabaret, an hour of costumes, live singing and big stage sets close to Patong beach.

activities.name: Bangla Road After Dark
activities.description: Patong's night strip, closed to traffic after dark and lined with bars, street food and live music.
